core_struggle: Caring for a mother whose memory is fading, while the child who needed her most has just left for college; mind will not settle.
mirror: You dropped your child at college and drove home in silence.

queries.hook: The mind will not settle, caught between the child who no longer needs you and the mother who no longer knows you.
queries.diagnose: When what we love is passing, the heart aches because the bond was real; grief is love with nowhere to go.
queries.steady: What is real in us cannot be lost; the love that shaped you remains even when the form it wore is gone.
queries.act: Let the grief have its voice, offer one act of care that is yours alone, and let the rest go.
queries.story: A man who lost his father and had to rebuild his life shows what it means to carry love forward after the one who held it is gone.

bridge: The silence of that four-hour drive and the mother who no longer sees you are what the texts call the mind running after what is passing. It cannot hold.
week_thesis: The silence of that drive and the mother who no longer sees you become, over seven days, the ground beneath your feet rather than the wind in your mind.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the unmoored feeling, named without judgement.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that it is grief for two futures dissolving at once, and that the mind cannot settle while it tries to hold both.
week_beats.steady: You hold that what is real in you cannot be lost, and that love remains even when the form it wore is gone.
week_beats.act: You try letting the grief have its voice and offering one act of care that is yours alone.
week_beats.story: A man who lost his father and had to rebuild his life shows you how love continues after the one who held it is gone.

insight: Two loves are letting go at once, and the mind will not settle because it is trying to hold both. Underneath is grief for the future you imagined.
